verdict.rationale: Beamer's own docs claim 3,000+ integrations, integration with support apps to close the feedback loop, and a bi-directional HubSpot sync, so connecting third-party tools is a documented first-party capability. The 'in just a few clicks' part is not shown: there is no setup-flow documentation for any integration and no independent corroboration. Missing for 10: documented click-level setup flow for integrations, a list of which common tools connect natively versus through API/webhooks or third-party connectors, hands-on or independent confirmation of ease of setup.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can connect common third-party tools to my feedback workspace in just a few clicks

citations.quote: Find 3,000+ available integrations, API and Webhooks
Integrate with your favorite support apps to close the feedback loop.
Now you can connect HubSpot and Beamer better with the new bi-directional sync.
